title: "Phylogeny with Accessory genes"
output: html_document
date: "2025-10-23"

# Set up environment and load data 
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(phytools)
library(ape)
library(treeio)
library(reshape2)
library(ggnewscale)


# Load metadata
SCs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |> rename(Sample=Taxon, SC=Cluster)

# List samples from each dataset
NL_metadata <- read.xlsx("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/Netherlands_Sanger_metadata.xlsx", 1) 
NLD_samples <- NL_metadata |> filter(ENA.lane.accession %in% SCs$Sample) |> pull(ENA.lane.accession)
CDC_metadata <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/phenotypes.txt", header=T) 
CDC_samples <- CDC_metadata |> filter(samples %in% SCs$Sample) |> pull(samples)

# Add country to metadata
metadata <- SCs |> 
  mutate(Country= ifelse(Sample %in% NLD_samples, "NL", 
                         ifelse(Sample %in% CDC_samples, "USA", "TW")) )|> 
  filter(Country != "TW")

# Import tree
Fasttree <- read.tree("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/FastTree_phylo.tre")
Fasttree_mid <- midpoint.root(Fasttree)

# Recode Clusters into factor
fewer5_SC <- names(which(table(metadata$SC)<10))
metadata_tree_v0 <- metadata |> 
  mutate(SC2= ifelse(SC %in% fewer5_SC, "other", SC))|> 
  mutate(SC2= factor(SC2, level=c(1:length(which(table(metadata$SC)>=10)), "other")))|>
  mutate(Country = factor(Country, levels=c("NL", "USA")))|> 
  rename("label" = "Sample")|> 
  filter(label %in% Fasttree_mid$tip.label)

# Keep only tips with available metadata
Fasttree_mid_clean <- keep.tip(Fasttree_mid, metadata_tree_v0 |> filter(label %in% Fasttree_mid$tip.label) |> pull(label))

# join metadata and tree 
Fasttree_mid_clean_join <- full_join(Fasttree_mid_clean, metadata_tree_v0 |> dplyr::select(label, SC2) , by = 'label')

# Load gene presence/absence data
gene_pres_abs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/gene_presence_absence.csv")

# Reformat gene presence/absence data
gene_pres_abs_clean <- gene_pres_abs |>  
  dplyr::select(c("Gene", NLD_samples, CDC_samples)) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(c(NLD_samples, CDC_samples)), ~ ifelse(. == "", 0, 1)))

# Calculate the Total and proportion of samples carrying a given gene in each population
gene_pres_abs_clean_V2 <- gene_pres_abs_clean |> 
  mutate(Total= rowSums(across(all_of(c(NLD_samples, CDC_samples)))), 
         Total_NLD = rowSums(across(all_of(NLD_samples))), 
         Total_CDC = rowSums(across(all_of(CDC_samples))), 
         Proportion = Total/ length(c(NLD_samples, CDC_samples)),
         Proportion_NLD = Total_NLD/length(NLD_samples), 
         Proportion_CDC = Total_CDC/length(CDC_samples)) |> 
  filter(Total_NLD +Total_CDC !=0) |> 
  filter(Proportion_NLD>=0.05, Proportion_NLD<0.95) |> 
  filter(Proportion_CDC>=0.05, Proportion_CDC<0.95)

# Format for heatmap
Accessory_gene_heatmap_df <- data.frame(t(gene_pres_abs_clean_V2))[-1,]
colnames(Accessory_gene_heatmap_df) <- gene_pres_abs_clean_V2$Gene
Accessory_gene_heatmap_df
```

# Plot Tree with SC tips
```{r}
# Load libraries
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)

SC_colors <- c("#dbdb8d", "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd", 
                   "#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf",
                   "#f7b6d2", "#c5b0d5", "#c49c94", "black")

# plot tree tip (w legend)
p0x <- ggtree(Fasttree_mid_clean_join, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1) + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=as.factor(SC2)),size=1.5)+
  scale_colour_manual(name="SC", values=SC_colors)
p0x

# plot tree tip (w/out legend)
p0 <- ggtree(Fasttree_mid_clean_join, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1)

# ADD HEATMAPS
accessory_gene_colors <- c("darkblue", "white")
names(accessory_gene_colors)<- c(1,0)
p1 <- gheatmap(p0x + new_scale_fill(), Accessory_gene_heatmap_df,  width=0.8, offset=0.001,
               font.size = 5, colnames=FALSE , color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(name="Gene Presence/Absence",values = accessory_gene_colors)+
  theme(legend.position="none")
p1x <-  gheatmap(p0 + new_scale_fill(), Accessory_gene_heatmap_df,  width=0.8, offset=0.001,
               font.size = 5, colnames=FALSE , color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(name="Gene Presence/Absence",values = accessory_gene_colors)

# Add legends
# extract legends
library(ggpubr)
p0x_leg   <- get_legend(p0x)
p1x_leg   <- get_legend(p1x)

# plot object with legends
library(cowplot)
legend_plot_grid <- plot_grid(NULL,p0x_leg, NULL, p1x_leg,
          ncol = 1, rel_height = c(0.5, 0.7, 0.5, 0.2))

Final_phylo <- (plot_grid(p1, NULL,legend_plot_grid, NULL,  
           ncol = 4,
           rel_widths = c(0.5, 0.001, 0.1, 0.001)))
Final_phylo
```
